description: This is a Java class that implements the <call-class-method> element for a mini-language scripting engine within the OFBiz framework. It enables invoking static methods on a specified class with parameters during script execution.

classes.name: CallClassMethod
classes.description: Implements the <call-class-method> element which executes a static method call on a specified class with given parameters.

classes.name: CallClassMethodFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CallClassMethod.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the method call on the specified class using the provided method context.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the <call-class-method> element with its attributes.
